$comment: Hand-written. source.id is src.<component file>.<dom tag>, plus an ordinal suffix (.N = the N-th <tag opening in that file up to the cited line) where one file holds several sections with the same tag; verify_all.py traces the ordinal. A domSelector with a comma is a union: the section height is the bounding box of all matches (header = title plus the following line). Validates the provenance/taxonomy/retrieval fields every sections/*.json contract must carry. `source` is PROVENANCE (where in the source project the section comes from); `semantic` is TAXONOMY (what the section means in the design system). They are separate, closed objects and must never be merged or inferred from each other. extraction/verify_all.py and schema/semantic_validate.py (check_contracts) enforce the cross-field rules this schema cannot express.
title: Glaze section contract: provenance, taxonomy, retrieval
